_note: I057: note corrections found while writing docs/code/data-tables.md. (1) The formation lists have exactly as many rows as the record's +13 count in all 107 records that use one (the notes said 'at least'); five lists ($06, $0B, $0E, $29, $2B; 27 rows) are named by no record (OQ-I057-2). (2) LairRecords +A is the world index of the lair location in 403 of 420 records (0 in the 15 fillers and in $74, $75), ORed into lair_state by the release; no reader tests the low bits (OQ-I057-1). (3) Five dream rows have count 0, not three: $79 and $E7 carry RunLairRespawn but never spawn (OQ-I057-3). (4) The records are grouped by world. (5) The reader of CircleHalfWidths is BuildSoulOrbCircleWindow, the shape is the circular window of the four Soul effects (settles OQ-I033-9), and the table is mirrored about row 64. (6) The sine table is only close to 127 x sin and its negative half is not the exact negation. (7) The retype proposals of FM-A11 4.17 are now pointed to by OQ-I033-10 and the document.

edit.find: so every list must have at least as many rows as the lair has monsters.
edit.with: so every list must have at least as many rows as the lair has monsters (in all 107 records that use a formation the list has exactly as many rows as the record's +13).

Check: 224 + 434 x 6 = 2828 bytes. The 107 records use 107 different lists (407 rows); the other five (indices $06, $0B, $0E, $29 and $2B; 10, 3, 6, 4 and 4 rows) are named by no record (OQ-I057-2, docs/code/data-tables.md).

edit.find: Out: 112 lists of 434 rows in all; no list terminator (the lair's monster count ends the walk).
edit.with: Out: 112 lists of 434 rows in all (107 used, five named by no record: OQ-I057-2); no list terminator (the lair's monster count ends the walk and equals the row count of every used list).

edit.find: The records are not sorted by location.
edit.with: The records are not sorted by location; they are grouped by the world of the lair location (world 0 $00-$34, world 1 $36-$76, world 2 $77-$C3, world 3 $C4-$103, world 4 $109-$155, world 5 $158-$195, world 6 $196-$1A3), with the 15 fillers in the gaps.
